title: The Beginning of Breaking the局
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji obtained the ironclad evidence, the Heavenly Eye in the sky suddenly became clearer, as if something was watching him—a being beyond mortal comprehension, reassessing this unruly chess piece on the board.

text.content: The night wind was biting cold. Chen Ji stood alone at the Cliff Edge of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, gazing down at the cloud-shrouded sect below. He slowly unclenched his fist, his knuckles trembling slightly from the overbearing grip. A chess piece? A discarded piece? A cold sneer curled at the corner of his lips, that smile seeming especially icy in the darkness. Su Qingyao's words still echoed in his ears, each word cutting at his heart like a blade. He raised his head, looking toward the faintly visible Heavenly Eye in the night sky—that all-seeing existence that had always treated him as a puppet on strings.

"Good, very good." Chen Ji murmured to himself, his voice terrifyingly calm. He retrieved the incomplete Tianji Record from his chest. The yellowed pages glistened with an eerie glow under the moonlight. Since you want to see me play the chess piece, let me show you how a single piece can overturn the entire game. He took a deep breath, a resolute gleam flickering in his eyes. From this moment on, he was no longer the passive waste of a disciple taking beatings. He would take the initiative, let those hidden manipulators know—Chen Ji never settles for being a chess piece.

dialogue.content: The voice of the remnant soul rang in his mind, carrying rare solemnity: "Boy, have you thought this through? Taking the initiative means exposing that you've seen through the game. Those existences will become even more vigilant." Mo Xiansheng paused, "But it also means you're no longer a lamb waiting to be slaughtered."

text.content: Chen Ji didn't respond to Mo Xiansheng. Instead, he focused all his attention on the Tianji Record. He attempted to use this mysterious technique in reverse—not passively waiting for foresight, but actively demanding information from the Tianji Record. Such an approach was unprecedented, but he faintly sensed that the depths of the Tianji Record still held many untapped abilities. The runes on the pages began to pulse violently, as if sensing his will.

choice.prompt: Under the reverse activation, the Tianji Record unexpectedly revealed a new ability beyond foresight! Chen Ji had to make a choice—this ability would consume more Heavenly Fate Value, but the effects would be entirely different—

choices.text: "Fate Tracking"—Lock onto a specific target's complete past
choices.description: Consuming 15 points of Heavenly Fate Value, allowing one to completely spy out all secrets of a target, including evidence chains of their collusion with external forces. This is the most direct approach, but the cost is extremely high.
choices.risk_hint: Low Heavenly Fate Value accelerates counterattack

text.content: The Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with blinding golden light, an information flow flooding into Chen Ji's mind like a tide. He saw it—the entire process of the Fifth Elder's remnant faction's secret communications with the Xuanwu Sect, every meeting's time and location, every transaction record, even the traces of manipulation by former Sect Master Ling Yuan in the shadows!

choices.description: Consuming 10 points of Heavenly Fate Value, allowing simultaneous foresight of all possible branching paths within three hours, finding the optimal solution. This ability is more covert, but the information is relatively fragmented.
choices.visible_reward: Grasp initiative of the overall situation
choices.risk_hint: Requires extremely strong logical reasoning ability

text.content: The runes on the Tianji Record transformed into countless rays of light, weaving a complex web of fate before Chen Ji's eyes. Every node was a possibility, every branch leading to a different outcome. He saw the traps set by enemies, and also the key to breaking the局—the Fifth Elder's trusted disciple was precisely the weakest link in the entire conspiracy chain.

Just as Chen Ji was digesting this information, a strange vibration came from the depths of the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul exclaimed in surprise: "This... this is an ability the Tianji Record has never shown before! It's responding to your will, boy. You've activated the 'Reverse Fate' function that has been dormant in the fragment for ages!" Chen Ji felt an unprecedented power flowing through his body. The Tianji Record was no longer merely a foresight tool, but a true blade for breaking the局.

dialogue.content: "Reverse Fate... this is a realm that none of the previous Tianji Record holders have ever touched." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried disbelief, "It can make your schemes perfectly align with the River of Destiny, making every calculation seem like predestination. Use it carefully. This ability is too powerful and will also attract true attention."

text.content: Chen Ji's smile deepened. True attention? At this moment, the thing he feared least was being watched. What he wanted was for those hidden existences to see him, to make them think the chess game was still under their control, to let them walk step by step into the trap he had personally woven. The waste disciple was counterattacking, and the entire Tianqing Sect would tremble for it tomorrow.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji had now obtained key evidence and discovered vulnerabilities in the enemy's layout. Now he needed to choose his course of action—steady and methodical, or bold and aggressive?

choices.description: Don't strike directly. Instead, cleverly deliver the evidence to Su Qingyao's hands, letting her expose this conspiracy. This way, he could protect his waste persona while ensuring he stayed out of the spotlight once the conspiracy was revealed.

text.content: Chen Ji compiled the evidence into a seemingly unintentional 'lost item,' arranging it on the path the Fifth Elder's trusted disciple would inevitably take. When Su Qingyao picked up this 'unexpected windfall,' Chen Ji had long since vanished into the crowd, leaving only a meaningful silhouette behind.

choices.memory_label: 陈机选择通过我来揭露真相，他的布局越来越深了

choices.description: Personally step forward and publicly expose the Fifth Elder's remnant faction's conspiracy. This would move him from behind the scenes to center stage, but the reputation and influence gained would also be immense. Of course, this would also make former Sect Master Ling Yuan even more vigilant toward him.

text.content: The next morning, at the Tianqing Sect Council Hall. Chen Ji shed his usual cowardly demeanor and, before all the elders and disciples, presented the ironclad evidence of the Fifth Elder's remnant faction's betrayal of the sect. Those who had mocked him as a废物 were all stunned speechless, while Chen Ji simply watched it all calmly, as if admiring a play whose ending he had known all along.

No matter which path he chose, Chen Ji had already made thorough preparations. He knew the sect's operating rules too well—on the surface a bastion of morality and discipline, but secretly filled with factional struggles and利益 exchanges. Did the Fifth Elder's remnant faction think that latching onto the Xuanwu Sect would guarantee their safety? What they didn't know was that from their very first secret meeting, Chen Ji had been secretly recording everything.

Evidence was conclusive, with both material proof and witnesses. The Fifth Elder's trusted disciple was captured on the spot. Facing the overwhelming evidence, his face turned as pale as paper, trembling on the ground. The other elders involved in the conspiracy also had faces ashen with despair. They never imagined that Chen Ji, always dismissed as a废物, was the true mastermind behind this storm.

dialogue.content: "废物! How dare you—" Han Lie, the first genius of the Xuanwu Sect, rushed over upon hearing the news, his eyes crimson with rage. He was one of the external contacts for this conspiracy. Originally certain of success, he had been thoroughly ruined by Chen Ji. Spiritual energy surged around him like a wild tide: "I'll teach you the consequences of provoking the Xuanwu Sect!"

text.content: Chen Ji stood his ground without retreating even a single step. He raised his head, directly meeting Han Lie's murderous gaze, a mocking curve forming at the corner of his lips. "Han Lie Shixiong, are you certain you want to act here?" His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears: "Before all the elders and disciples of the Tianqing Sect, publicly defending a traitor who colluded with foreign enemies—is this the upbringing of the Xuanwu Sect?"

dialogue.content: Han Lie's face turned ashen, his imposing aura faltering. Though reckless, he wasn't stupid. Chen Ji's words put him in an impossible position. If he really made a move, it would confirm the Xuanwu Sect's collusion with the Tianqing Sect's traitors. He ground his teeth, staring at Chen Ji, his voice low as a beast's growl: "Good, very good! Chen Ji, remember this!" With that, he turned and stormed away, his silhouette exuding deep-seated hatred.

text.content: A wave of whispered discussions arose around them. Those who had once looked down on Chen Ji now had eyes filled with more wariness and scrutiny. Yet Chen Ji simply stood quietly, as if that earth-shaking performance had been a trivial matter. But the moment he lowered his head, his peripheral vision caught a gloomy gaze in the back of the crowd—that was Ling Yuan's former Sect Master's trusted aide, silently withdrawing from the gathering.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji discovered that Ling Yuan's informant was secretly retreating—he had to decide before that person reported back: let this lead disappear, or take the opportunity to follow the vine and catch bigger fish?

choices.text: Follow the vine and catch bigger fish
choices.description: Secretly track that informant and see what bigger fish he can lead to. This might uncover evidence chains directly involving former Sect Master Ling Yuan, but the risk is extremely high. Once discovered, the consequences would be unimaginable.

text.content: Chen Ji executed his concealment technique, silently trailing the informant. He watched as the person turned and twisted through various paths, finally entering a remote courtyard. When he glimpsed the person in the courtyard, his heart was shaken—it was actually Ling Yuan's personal disciple, that "good Shixiong" who had always been so caring and attentive to Chen Ji!

choices.description: Today's harvest has been too great. Don't be greedy. Temporarily let this lead go, preserve your strength, and wait for a better opportunity. Former Sect Master Ling Yuan isn't going anywhere. His fox tail will eventually show. Time is on Chen Ji's side.

text.content: Chen Ji watched that informant leave, a cold gleam flickering in his eyes. The good show has just begun, and he has plenty of patience. Former Sect Master Ling Yuan spent decades laying his plans. Chen Ji only needed to wait for one flaw, one fatal flaw. Tonight, he had already won enough筹码.

Night fell. The Tianqing Sect returned to its surface calm. But everyone knew that today's events would soon trigger a massive earthquake. The downfall of the Fifth Elder's remnant faction was only the beginning of this storm. And Chen Ji, standing at the eye of this storm, stood quietly in his own courtyard, gazing up at the night sky.

Suddenly, his pupils contracted. The originally faint Heavenly Eye in the night sky had become extremely clear, as if a giant eye was gazing directly at him. This was no ordinary phenomenon, but a projection of some existence beyond mortal comprehension. Chen Ji felt an inexplicable chill rise along his spine—his actions today had touched a strand of destiny that should never have been touched.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying unprecedented gravity: "Boy, do you feel it? The Heavenly Eye... it's looking at you. More focused, more serious than ever before. Your actions today in breaking the局 have drawn its attention." The remnant soul paused, his voice low: "From now on, you will no longer be a chess piece or a discarded piece, but—prey."

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at that crystal-clear Heavenly Eye, and once again a smile curved his lips. This time, that smile held no fear, only boundless battle intent. Since Heaven intends to make him prey, then he would show Heaven—there's always some chess pieces that can overturn the entire game. The beginning of breaking the局 starts tonight.
